comparison: Expert Demonstrations versus the union of four off-expert action families.
sampling: Event-aligned action chunks with equal counts per action family.
descriptor: Current dual-arm state plus eight time-normalized knots of relative translation, relative rotation, and gripper state for both arms.
embedding: Training-only PCA fitted once to all expert and off-expert samples.
display_region: Expert: 95% highest-density KDE region. Off-expert: union of the four family-wise 95% highest-density KDE regions.
display_sampling: Scatter display only: 20 of 50 samples per category are selected by deterministic stratified hash sampling with salt 20260801. All 50 samples per category are retained for KDE support estimation.
